Tokens, motion, ui, and the runifly, nostr, and exosquare themes are 0.4.0. patterns stays a 0.0.0 stub. This covers everything since 0.3.0.

The sheet scrim is a dark wash. `--scrim-base` is `#000` and `--color-scrim` mixes that base with `--overlay-opacity`. Light schemes use 40% opacity. Dark schemes use 60%. A light scheme keeps 40% inside a dark page. The nostr theme uses `#070808`, at 40% in light and 64% in dark.

While a sheet is open, a toast sits clear of its actions. On a narrow viewport it sits at the top. On a wider viewport it sits above the sheet.

The switch is a pill. `--radius-switch` follows `--radius-full`, including under a nested theme. The off thumb uses `--color-border-strong`. `Switch` takes an optional `hint`, rendered under the label and exposed with `aria-describedby`. The row is at least `--control-height` tall.

Field hints and errors use the display face. An invalid field uses a danger focus ring, `var(--color-danger-fg)`.

`Button` adds `variant="danger-solid"`. The fill, hover, and label come from `--color-danger-solid`, `--color-danger-solid-hover`, and `--color-danger-solid-on`. The focus ring uses `var(--color-danger-fg)`. The soft `danger` variant is unchanged. A destructive `ConfirmSheet` uses the solid button for its confirming action. Initial focus stays on Cancel. Runifly and exosquare dark use a temporary solid until their own brand direction is set.

Nostr motion v7 makes navigation instant. Surface, press, and release use the strong ease-out. The celebrate spring is tighter. Hover lift and hover scale are gone. Toasts enter with the surface tween. `@macro88/motion` adds `--motion-release-duration` and `--motion-release-ease` in `tokens.css`. Its JavaScript exports are unchanged.

`@macro88/theme-nostr` adds `inkChop`, `nowLine`, `radius`, `inboxRowExit`, and `inboxRowExitReduced`, and the transition keys `listExitInstant`, `layoutInstant`, `reasonReveal`, `qrReveal`, and `skeleton`. `.motion-skeleton`, `.motion-check`, and `.motion-hover-elevation` are new. `.ink-rule` reads `--motion-ink-chop-size` and `--motion-ink-chop-thickness` and does not animate. Failed status colour is `--color-status-danger-fg` and `--color-status-danger-bg` (`colour.statusDangerFg`, `colour.statusDangerBg`, `colour.failedFg`, `colour.failedBg`). Missed uses the warning pair (`colour.missedFg`, `colour.missedBg`). `--color-danger-fg` and `--color-danger-bg` stay for fields and destructive actions.

These packages are not on npm. Install the tarballs attached below by URL, and add a pnpm override for every @macro88 package so pnpm doesn't look for them on npm. INSTALL.md has the full setup. Checksums for every tarball are in SHA256SUMS.

## Migration

The removed names below were exports and custom properties of `@macro88/theme-nostr`. `@macro88/motion` did not export them in 0.3.0, and it does not export them in 0.4.0.

`feel.hoverLift`, `feel.cardHoverLift`, `feel.rowHoverLift`, `feel.labelEnterY`, `feel.hoverScale`, and `feel.cardHoverScale` are gone, with no replacement. `transitions.buttonHover` no longer scales or lifts.

```ts
import { feel, transitions } from "@macro88/theme-nostr";

// 0.3.0
transitions.buttonHover;
// { scale: feel.hoverScale, y: feel.hoverLift, boxShadow, transition }

// 0.4.0
transitions.buttonHover;
// { boxShadow, transition: motion.feedback }
// feel.hoverScale and feel.hoverLift are not exported
```

`colour.check` is removed. The check colour is the custom property `--motion-check-colour`. `.motion-check` sets `color` to that property.

```ts
import { colour } from "@macro88/theme-nostr";

// 0.3.0
colour.check; // "var(--color-accent)"

// 0.4.0
// colour.check is not exported.
// color: var(--motion-check-colour)
```

These custom properties are removed, with no replacement: `--motion-hover-lift`, `--motion-card-hover-lift`, `--motion-row-hover-lift`, `--motion-label-enter-y`, `--motion-hover-scale`, `--motion-card-hover-scale`. The Tailwind utilities `--scale-hover` and `--scale-card-hover` are removed with them.

`transitions.buttonRest` used `motion.reorder`, which is `spring.lively`. It now uses `motion.release`, a 120ms tween on `ease.out`. The toast enter used the same spring. It now uses `motion.surface`.

```ts
import { motion, transitions } from "@macro88/theme-nostr";

// 0.3.0
transitions.buttonRest.transition; // motion.reorder
transitions.toast.animate.transition; // motion.reorder

// 0.4.0
transitions.buttonRest.transition; // motion.release
transitions.toast.animate.transition; // motion.surface
```

A section change no longer fades. `transitions.section` stays at full opacity, and `feel.sectionEnterY` is `0`. `motion.navigate` is a 0ms tween on `ease.out`.

`chipArc` returns `bow`. A mostly horizontal flight is `"up"`. A mostly vertical flight is `"right"`.

```ts
import { chipArc } from "@macro88/theme-nostr";

chipArc(120, 40).bow; // "up"
chipArc(40, 120).bow; // "right"
```

Hints and errors use the display face. If a hint should stay in the body face, add `font-body`:

```tsx
<FormMessage className="font-body">Only you see this.</FormMessage>
```
